title: nerv update [--check]: fetch, compare and run the lifecycle update
goal: One command checks origin/main and, when behind, runs stop, lifecycle update and start, then probes the dashboard
acceptance: --check prints up to date or behind by N commits without changing anything
A behind base completes stop → update → start through planService/applyService and reports the new revision
Any refusal prints the blockers and the recovery steps
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no personal data.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-23 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
